mapper.select: SELECT FROM sekai_Draw_lots_character ORDER BY popularity_score DESC, id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DISTINCT role_type FROM sekai_Draw_lots_character WHERE enabled = TRUE AND role_type <> 'archived' ORDER BY role_type
SELECT DISTINCT energy FROM sekai_Draw_lots_character WHERE enabled = TRUE AND energy IS NOT NULL ORDER BY energy
mapper.sql: FROM sekai_Draw_lots_record r JOIN sekai_Draw_lots_character c ON c.id = r.character_id JOIN sekai_Draw_lots_fortune f ON f.id = r.fortune_id
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.character_id, r.fortune_id, r.fortune_score AS luck_score, r.mood, r.wish_topic, r.message, r.draw_time, r.draw_type, r.daily_date, r.ritual_id, r.wish_id, c.id AS c_id, c.english_name, c.anime_title, c.role_type AS archetype, c.energy AS element, c.image_url, c.tags AS quote, c.popularity_score AS popularity, f.id AS f_id, f.summary AS title, f.level_name, f.advice, f.lucky_color, f.lucky_item
ORDER BY r.draw_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
